title: Para Bellum content: traits
description: A named, composable effect: sloped armour, wet stowage, night optics. File: Content/<namespace>/trait.json. Each modifier writes one contribution into the game's modifier pipeline, with source trait:<id>, in the Base layer. Contributions within a layer add; layers multiply. A trait is legal on a class only if that class lists it, and only if every stat it modifies is on that class. The contract is docs/design/CONTENT_MODEL.md section 3 in the game repository.

name.description: Display name. Optional: a missing or blank name displays the id.

per_mille.description: The change in thousandths: 300 is +30%, -100 is -10%. A whole number.
